conviction_note: The monthlies make H1 revenue almost exactly knowable (~¥119.0bn, +6.7%) so there is no sales surprise; the unobservable is margin, and Q1's -94bp OP-margin collapse was attributed by the company to 人件費 and 減価償却費 from the Feb-2026 four-store wave, which do not reverse in Q2 — so H1 OP should land near -10% YoY at a ~42% 進捗率 against a ~48% norm. I size the reaction at -2.6 rather than the -3.9 finding sum because this exact holder base already looked through an identical -10.5% Q1 on 2026-06-24 and the stock is higher now than it was that week (3,990 -> 4,020), and because PBR 1.03x / PER 9.9x is real valuation support; the extra width over the 2.3% median reaction comes from the ~35% chance the full-year guide is formally cut at this print.
bar: The company's own FY2027/2 会社予想 — 営業収益 ¥245,622m (+8.8%), 営業利益 ¥12,590m (+0.9%), 経常利益 ¥12,580m (+0.1%), 純利益 ¥8,660m (-3.6%), announced 2026-04-10 (https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZRST0501415Q6A410C2000000/) and reaffirmed at Q1 on 2026-06-24. There is NO published sell-side consensus — IFIS 株予報 shows a dash for analyst forecasts (https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&bcode=2742&sa=report) — so the only bar is the company guide and the 進捗率 against it. Plan-implied H1 営業利益 = 47.7% of ¥12,590m = ~¥6,005m (47.7% is last year's H1 経常 progress against the then-current FY guide). My estimate is ~¥5,250m, hence -12%.
positioning_check: JPX 空売り残高報告: ZERO disclosed short positions at or above the 0.5% threshold as of 2026-09-18 (sealed baseline, source https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html) — a real zero, so there is no squeeze fuel behind a negative and equally no crowded short already positioned for it. 信用倍率 6.21 (margin long balance 6.2x margin short balance, baseline as of 2026-09-18): a retail long overhang, which is the supply that shows up on a disappointing print and is the reason the baseline's own lean is -0.46. Days-to-cover is not computable — no aggregate short balance is published for a name with no disclosed reporters. There is no skew: Japan has no liquid single-stock option market, so `options` is all-null and nothing in the price states a direction out loud.

findings.finding: H1 operating profit should land near ¥5.2bn, about -10% YoY, for a 進捗率 of ~42% against the ¥12,590m full-year guide versus a ~48% norm — because the Q1 margin collapse (OP margin 5.65% -> 4.71%, -94bp, on 人件費 and 減価償却費 from the four stores opened in February 2026) is structural and repeats in Q2, while the only H1 series most holders track — the monthly 既存店 line — improved from June's -1.3% to August's +2.2% and reads like a recovery.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year's H1 短信 was disclosed 2025-09-26 15:30 JST (https://ccreb-gateway.jp/ir-storage-detail/?id=1135316) and the first full session after it, 2025-09-29, carries the largest negative move in the baseline's twelve-event set at -3.5% — on an H1 that was 増収増益 (revenue +8.0%, OP +1.9%). This shareholder base sold a growing H1. The counterweight is the more recent one: the Q1 print of 2026-06-24 showed OP -10.5% and the stock was ~3,990 that week against 4,020 now, so a same-magnitude profit decline at Q1 was absorbed without lasting damage. Baseline median |move| over twelve estimated events is 2.3%, max 4.59%.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-18 (page as fetched; carries 2026/03 through 2026/08 monthly rows)
findings.why_not_priced: If the market had reconciled the two series it would not be leaving the stock flat: the monthly page shows all-store +6.1/+5.7/+9.7/+4.4/+6.1/+7.9% and existing-store ending the half at its best reading of the period, which reads as a business re-accelerating. The profit series says the opposite and only Q1 of it is visible. With zero published analyst estimates (IFIS blank) there is no number on the tape that forces the two to be reconciled, and the 20-day run-up is +1.26% — a stock that had absorbed an H1 profit decline of this size would not be sitting mid-range at 4,020 between a 3,595 low and a 4,550 high on the same six-month tape.
findings.independence: The H1 base it is measured against comes from a different source: FY2026/2 H1 actuals of 営業収益 ¥111,549m (+8.0%), 営業利益 ¥5,858m (+1.9%), 経常利益 ¥5,905m (+2.5%) — https://diamond-rm.net/flash_news/523550/. The Q1 figures and the 21.8%-vs-24.7% progress comparison come from IFIS 株予報, https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&bcode=2742&sa=report, and from https://nikkeiyosoku.com/stock/2742/ (Q1 営業収益 ¥57,876m +7.2%, 営業利益 ¥2,728m -10.5%, 経常 ¥2,747m -10.2%). NOTE: this finding shares its arithmetic with the guidance finding below — the guidance finding is sized only as the incremental cost of a formal revision, not as a second reading of the same H1 number.

findings.finding: Holding the FY2027/2 guide of ¥12,590m OP requires H2 operating profit of roughly ¥7.34bn, +11% YoY, off an H1 running about -10% — and the entire Oct 1 2026 minimum-wage increase (national weighted average to ¥1,177, +¥56/+5.0%; Okayama ¥1,104 +57, Kagawa ¥1,092 +56) falls inside that H2, so the probability of a 業績予想の修正 being attached to this 短信 is materially higher than the market's default for a company marketing '14期連続最高益'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No downward revision exists in this name's recent record to score directly — the company has revised UP or held. It held the guide at Q1 on 2026-06-24 despite OP -10.5% (https://nikkeiyosoku.com/stock/2742/), which is the single best evidence for the 'they hold again' case and is why this is sized at roughly a third of the move a cut would produce rather than at the cut itself. On the 進捗率 line generally, the baseline's twelve estimated reactions run -3.5% to +4.59% with a 2.3% median, so this name has never travelled far on any single line.
findings.source_date: 2026-09 (KSB 瀬戸内海放送 via Yahoo News; the 答申 figures for Okayama ¥1,104 and Kagawa ¥1,092, effective 2026-10-01)
findings.why_not_priced: No 業績予想の修正 has been filed — the company's timely-disclosure record shows nothing between 2026-07-17 (組織新設) and today (https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/2742.T/disclosure), so unlike the 73-of-456 names that pre-release on a heavy TDnet day, this number is entirely unreleased. If the market were carrying a cut it would not be paying 9.9x forward earnings on a guide it expected to be withdrawn, and the stock would not have recovered the whole post-Q1 drawdown. The wage number itself is public and sector-wide; what is not priced is its collision with a guide that already needs a +11% H2 to stand up.
findings.independence: The wage decision is corroborated independently at https://taxlabor.com/kagawa-minimum-wage/ (Kagawa ¥1,092 from 2026-10-01, +¥56). The H2 arithmetic rests on the same H1 estimate as finding 1 — declared, not independent — and the FY guide itself is sourced separately to https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZRST0501415Q6A410C2000000/ (2026-04-10).

findings.finding: Lopia entered Halows' home market during this half — 広島パセーラ店 2026-04-03 (its first store in Chugoku/Shikoku), 新市店 in Fukuyama 2026-05-15, アルパーク店 in Hiroshima early July — and Halows has responded by cutting prices on selected flyer items across northern Fukuyama, a gross-margin action that appears nowhere in the sales series and is not aggregated anywhere outside the local press.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print in this name has turned on a competitive-entry line, so there is no reaction history to cite; this is sized as a small qualitative addition to the margin story rather than as its own event. The 2025-09-29 -3.5% after last year's H1 is the only evidence that this holder base will sell a margin narrative at an H1 print.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-09 (Chugoku Shimbun Digital via Yahoo News; the sentence is 「ハローズ（福山市）は、福山市北部エリアでチラシに載せる一部商品の値段を下げた。」)
findings.why_not_priced: The whole record of it is one regional newspaper series nine days old, behind a partial paywall, with no wire pickup and no sell-side note anywhere to carry it — IFIS shows no analyst forecast at all for this name. If it had been priced, a supermarket whose headquarters city has just been entered by the cheapest operator in Japan would not still be quoted at 1.03x book with a +1.26% 20-day run-in. Net of the rest of the company this is small: northern Fukuyama is a handful of a 113-store base, and August all-store +7.9% with existing-store traffic +1.3% says Halows is not losing aggregate share — which is exactly why I size it at -0.6 and not more.
findings.independence: Lopia's own operator confirms the openings and the cadence from a different source: OIC Group press release 2026-05-07 for 新市店 opening 2026-05-15 (https://oicgroup.co.jp/docs/release/2026-05-07-%E5%82%99%E5%BE%8C%E3%82%A8%E3%83%AA%E3%82%A2%E5%88%9D%E3%80%81%E5%BA%83%E5%B3%B6%E7%9C%8C%E5%86%852%E5%8F%B7%E5%BA%97%E3%81%A8%E3%81%AA%E3%82%8B%E3%80%8C%E3%83%AD%E3%83%94%E3%82%A2%20%E6%96%B0%E5%B8%82%E5%BA%97%E3%80%8D%E3%81%8C5%E6%9C%8815%E6%97%A5%E3%82%AA%E3%83%BC%E3%83%97%E3%83%B3.pdf), and Halows' own 2026-04-09 renovation of its 戸手店 in the same 新市町 (https://www.ryutsuu.biz/store/s040941.html) is a defensive capital action in the same postcode five weeks before Lopia arrived. What does NOT support a Lopia reading: Halows' June existing-store -1.3% is explained by an industry-wide event, not by Lopia — the three supermarket associations reported the first YoY decline in 40 months for June 2026 on rice base effects and rice price deflation (https://shokuhin.net/153929/2026/07/23/ryutu/kouri/), and that broad series beats the narrow inference, so I have deliberately not built any part of this finding on the June number.

outside_window.finding: September 2026 月次 (monthly / 既存店) sales, the first month of H2 and the first read on whether Lopia's July Alpark opening bites, publishes in the first days of October — after the exit.
The Oct 1 2026 minimum-wage step (+5.0% national, Okayama ¥1,104, Kagawa ¥1,092) takes effect after the exit and its P&L consequence is only visible from the Q3 print in late December.
Halows' next new store, 川南モール in Fukuyama, opens 2026-12-01 (staff recruitment notice posted 2026-09-16) — the H2 revenue that the +8.8% full-year guide depends on, resolving long after the exit.
Lopia's remaining planned openings in Hiroshima and Yamaguchi (four stores in total by February 2027) land inside H2 and are the real test of the competitive thesis.

searched_and_found_nothing: TDnet / Yahoo!ファイナンス適時開示 for a 業績予想の修正 or 配当予想の修正 already filed ahead of the print — none exists; the last disclosure of any kind is 2026-07-17 組織新設, so the H1 number is entirely unreleased
Any published sell-side consensus or target price for 2742 — IFIS 株予報 returns a dash for analyst forecasts, so there is no consensus bar to beat and no coverage to be surprised
A company-published 上期 (H1) forecast separate from the full-year guide — Halows guides full-year only, which is why the bar has to be reconstructed from the 進捗率
Any Halows disclosure quantifying the Lopia impact, or any 決算説明会資料 for FY2027/2 giving the H1/H2 store-opening split — the company's IR calendar has not been updated past FY2026/2
EDINET 有価証券報告書 risk-wording changes — the FY2027/2 filing post-dates the AGM and no diff was retrievable in the time available
OpenWork / 転職会議 employee reviews and the 採用 pages by 職種 for a hiring-freeze or wage signal — nothing datable or company-specific enough to source
Yahoo!ファイナンス掲示板 / 5ch holder argument — only generic valuation chatter (PER ~9.7x 'still cheap'), nothing that constitutes a finding

Electricity/gas subsidy YoY delta for the Jul-Sep 2026 quarter — the support was resumed for Jul-Sep 2026 usage (METI 2026-06-12) but I could not establish the prior-year comparison cleanly, and at 高圧 rates of ¥1.8-2.3/kWh the effect on a 113-store chain is too small to size

Rice-deflation effect on gross margin (shelf price -23% Feb-to-Aug 2026) — directionally it could HELP blended margin via mix away from a low-margin staple, and I could find nothing Halows-specific, so I have not sized it in either direction
baseline_tension: It agrees with the baseline rather than cutting against it — the run-up is only +1.26% so there is almost nothing directional built in, and the baseline's own -0.46 lean is driven by the same 信用倍率 6.21 retail long overhang that would supply the selling on a weak H1, so my negative is additive to the free control rather than fighting it; the honest discomfort is that the free control already points the same way and the incremental information I am adding is one quarter of unobservable margin.
lessons_applied: nothing changed — researcher_japan/LESSONS.md is deliberately empty of rules ('Nothing yet. No Japanese run has resolved.') and its three 進捗率 / 月次 / 業績予想の修正 items are written as open questions for the first post-mortems, not as guidance, so there was nothing in it that could legitimately re-size or drop a finding; the pre and post sums are equal honestly.

For the record against open question 2 ('do monthly disclosures pre-empt the print?'): this name is the strong case FOR pre-emption on revenue — the six monthly rows reconstruct H1 営業収益 to within ~0.1% (¥119.0bn against a ¥111,549m base) so there is zero sales surprise — and the case AGAINST it on profit, which the monthlies do not contain. I had already sized finding 1 on that distinction before opening the file, so the file left it standing.

For the record against open question 1 ('does the 進捗率 beat everything else?'): both of my two largest findings are 進捗率 findings, and with no sell-side consensus published for this name there was literally no other bar available.
